acceptance: Every deduction bucket the packet can produce (EXEMPT_SHORT_TERM_RENTAL, EXEMPT_CUSTOMER_OTHER, OUTSIDE_AREA, NOT_TAXED_CATEGORY) has a researched recommended default — Schedule A label plus DEDUCTION treatment — in one code table with a plain-words reason and its source, and a packet built for an account with no saved labels shows those defaults instead of "Not decided — ask your CPA".

A deduction line whose wording came from the researched default is marked "Researched default — CPA confirmation still pending" wherever the packet shows it; a line with owner-saved wording is not marked; totals and tax due are identical either way.

The deduction wording is edited per bucket on its own page — label text and how the amount is reported, in plain words — with the recommended default and its reason shown and a per-bucket restore; saving never requires editing JSON.
New filing accounts start with the researched defaults as their starting labels, marked as researched defaults until the owner edits a bucket.
A bucket with no researched default and no saved label still shows "Not decided — ask your CPA" with the packet warning, so an uncomputable or unresearched bucket (S-T9) stays visibly undecided.

The deduction wording is also editable by the business's accountant (Accountant role): the dedicated save re-checks the actor in the transaction (owner or active accountant only), writes only the deduction labels, audit-logs saver, role and per-bucket old and new values, and stamps provenance from the editor — a bucket an accountant sets or confirms reads as accountant-set and its pending-CPA label clears.

The decision is recorded: a dated research note in docs/research/, a DECISIONS.md entry, the IN-44 row in OWNER-INPUTS.md updated to "researched default applied 2026-10-31 on Chris's instruction; CPA confirmation still sought", and a dated amendment note on D-WA5 in BATCH-W.md (the original text is not rewritten).
